ctx.x: Well, that leads me to the next question that I had. And that is, up to this time, when you were playing with various bass players, I'd like to know just how you interacted with them. Well, both of you were keeping time. And sometimes, of course, one may go a little faster than the other, but the drummer is the important person in being able to keep the tempo where it's supposed to be. When you were with King Oliver and when he was recording with people like, say, Clinton Walker, who was his... He played tuba a…
